# NickelReadingStats v0.3.0

Chapter bars and time-left estimates now also work for books bought in a
Tolino store. This is also the first release built and published by CI on
GitHub.

> **Deutsch, kurz:** Kapitelbalken und Restzeit-Schätzung funktionieren jetzt auch für Bücher aus einem Tolino-Shop (ohne Kopierschutz). Das Projekt ist von Codeberg nach GitHub umgezogen, und Releases werden ab jetzt automatisch gebaut. Installation wie bisher: `Kobo.tgz` nach `.kobo/` kopieren und neu starten.

## New

- **Tolino store books:** chapter bars and the "time left" estimate now also
  work for books bought in a Tolino store. On a Tolino these are regular EPUBs
  stored under `.kobo/kepub/`, which the mod did not pick up before. Activity
  (reading time, sessions, pages per minute) was already recorded for them.
- **Encrypted (DRM) books are skipped deliberately:** their chapters cannot be
  read without bypassing the DRM, which the mod does not do. They keep
  Activity data but show no chapter bars. Watermarked store books are not
  encrypted and are fully supported.

## Compatibility

- **Kobo firmware 5.18 and 6.0:** the firmware check (symbols, calling
  conventions, class layout, offsets) passes for Kobo 5.18.270971 and
  6.0.276679. The mod has not been tested on a Kobo device yet; feedback is
  welcome.
- Tolino firmware 5.18 remains the tested platform (5.18.264769).

## Project

- **Moved to GitHub:** the repository is now
  [dkuester/NickelReadingStats](https://github.com/dkuester/NickelReadingStats).
  The Codeberg repository is archived.
- **Releases are built by CI:** `Kobo.tgz` is cross-built from the tagged
  commit and published with `SHA256SUMS`.
- **New README** with screenshots, feature and compatibility tables. The
  technical details are in [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/dkuester/NickelReadingStats/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
  and [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](https://github.com/dkuester/NickelReadingStats/blob/main/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md).
- The "time left" estimate is no longer listed as a known limitation; it has
  been accurate since v0.2.0.

## Tested

On a Tolino with firmware 5.18.264769:
- Store book without DRM: chapter bars, read chapters highlighted and "time
  left" estimate work.
- Sideloaded EPUBs and Activity work as in v0.2.1.

Host tests (Qt 5 and Qt 6) and the ARM build run in CI. The firmware checks
against Tolino 5.18, Kobo 5.18 and Kobo 6.0 pass (run locally; the firmware
files are not part of the repository).

## Known limitations

- Encrypted (DRM) books show no chapter bars or "time left" estimate.
- A book made of a single large HTML file shows a single chapter bar.
- Kobo devices have not been tested on a device yet.
- Firmware 5.18+ (Qt 6) only; firmware 4.x is not supported.

## Install

1. Download `Kobo.tgz` from the assets below (checksums in `SHA256SUMS`).
2. Copy it to `.kobo/` on the device.
3. Eject; the device installs the update on the next start. If it does not
   restart by itself, restart it.

Updating from an earlier version needs no uninstall. To uninstall, place an
empty file `readingstats_uninstall` in the device root and restart.
